status.title: System Status
status.description: How dsh-mnemon, memory Providers and each storage layer are running.
status.workflowUnsupported: The current Strategy does not drive: {workflows}. Enabling review settings alone does not start these tasks. Select a Strategy that supports them, such as the Layered Strategy, in Memory System. Manual actions remain available.
status.reviewFailedDetail: This checkpoint did not complete and will not be replayed automatically. Later reviews respect the cooldown and session limit.
status.reviewPartial: Some writes committed. Reconcile the receipts below; they were not rolled back.
status.reviewTeamPaused: Idle review is paused by the Agent Teams compatibility setting. To keep reviewing, select “Scoped task Agent review” under Idle review on the dsh-mnemon page under Plugins. Recall and writeback settings are unchanged.
status.reviewToolAccessPaused: The completion tool required by automatic review is currently unavailable. This checkpoint was skipped without consuming an attempt. Access will be checked again after a later eligible conversation turn. Check this session’s tool restrictions or approval settings.
status.reviewWatermarkNext: Next review no earlier than {time}; a new eligible conversation checkpoint is still required.
status.reviewWatermarkPaused: Automatic review paused: persistent limits are unavailable.
status.reviewWatermarkRecovery: Stop Hosts using this storage root, inspect this session’s state or lock under state/idle-review, then reopen the session. Deleting state resets the limit; normal conversation and manual actions remain available.
